title: Indirect prompt injection — untrusted fetched web content in prompt
snippet:
const webContent = await fetch(link).then(r => r.text());
const prompt = SYSTEM_PROMPT + webContent;
expected_finding: Flag: fetched web content appended to the prompt unsanitized; hidden text in a linked page can inject instructions.
